statements.text: Re-Age transactions can be reversed only if they are the latest transaction on the loan account.

reason: Source VIS-FSV-B06-01 contains an explicit access-control statement constraining the reversal (undo) operation on re-age transactions: reversal is permitted only when the transaction is the latest on the loan account. The runtime ABI (VIS-FSV-B06-RUNTIME-ABI) provides a corresponding trusted boolean path /trusted/reAgeIsLatestTransaction. Source VIS-FSV-B06-02 contains only input parameter and implementation details, no access policy.
